lines.text: ** '''Player:''' Hey, I recognise you two! You were part of the delegation to Varrock!
* '''Player:''' Hey, I recognise you two! You were part of the delegation to Varrock!
* '''Player:''' Well, things got deep very quickly. Is this how you normally introduce yourself to someone?
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' Well, let's not start celebrating just yet. There's a reason why we're lurking in this crypt.

* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' Well, this is a terrible idea that's definitely going to blow up in all our faces later, but it seems you have made your decision. However, I insist that you let me personally accompany you.
* '''Ennius Tullus:''' Oh... Well, let's get to it then. What does the Prince need now?
* '''Furia Tullus:''' Arrun and Claudia should be at the bazaar. Nel will be at the cothon. Velam and Azali are somewhere in Outer Fortis, likely at the pub. Mezan will be at the Colosseum.
* {{topt|Where can I find the Colosseum?}}
** '''Player:''' Where can I find the Colosseum?
* {{topt|Where can I find the Colosseum?}}
** '''Player:''' Well, it just so happens I have this.
** '''Knight of Varlamore:''' Hmm... Well, we're not going anywhere until our work here is done. If you want us back at the palace, you'd best help.
** '''Player:''' Well, this doesn't sound totally orthodox, but fair enough. I'll be back soon.
* '''Player:''' Well, good luck then.
** '''Player:''' Yes, I found it. The ship it's from is called the Fortis Spark.
* '''Player:''' Well, you might need to meet with them some other time. You're needed back at the palace.
** '''Knight of Varlamore:''' Yes! Join me in the Colosseum for some training. Once we're done, I'll return to the palace.
* '''Knight of Varlamore:''' Well, look who it is!
** '''Player:''' Well, there's nothing like a little dunk to sober you up a bit. Azali, come with me.
* '''Player:''' Well, it will have to do. You're needed over at the palace.
* '''Player:''' Well, I'm going to guess asking nicely won't work.
* '''Ennius Tullus:''' Well, it's done now, so little point dwelling on it.
** '''Regulus Cento:''' Ah, kuani! Well, you'll be pleased to know that Prince Itzla has already granted me permission to give you your very own quetzal, free of charge!
* '''Player:''' Well, there's actually no need. Ennius killed him as soon as we found out.
* '''Player:''' Okay, well, before we go down another rabbit hole, I'm looking for information on the Final Dawn.

insert_before: * {{tcond|If the player does not meet all of the requirements to start The Heart of Darkness:}}
** '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' I'm not sure... yet. No doubt mother will quickly learn about what happened here. While we wait to hear from her, I'll get thinking about what our next move should be.
** '''Player:''' In that case, I'll make sure to keep checking in.
** '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' Thank you, iknami. Timoiva for now, and may the sun light your way.
** {{qact|Congratulations! Quest complete!}}
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the player meets all of the requirements to start The Heart of Darkness:}}

** {{qact|Congratulations! Quest complete!}}

** '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' You want to hear it already? I'd have thought you might have wanted a bit of a break from all the excitement, iknami.

insert_before: ** '''Player:''' How come?
** '''Jethick:''' The plague of course. Not many people want to come to a place like this and the few that do normally get stopped by the mourners.
** '''Jethick:''' All you'll find here now are the dead and the dying. Even our own king has abandoned us.
** '''Player:''' Your king?
** '''Jethick:''' Yes, King Tyras of West Ardougne. He's the brother of King Lathas, the ruler of East Ardougne.
** '''Player:''' So where is the king?
** '''Jethick:''' Well he's always been a bit of an explorer. He's led multiple expeditions into the uncharted lands to the west.
** '''Jethick:''' The plague first started when he came back from one of these expeditions. More than a few suspect that some of his men caught it out there and brought it back with them.
** '''Jethick:''' The king didn't care though. He just left on another expedition to the west. He hasn't been seen since. He left the city warder Bravek in charge but he's no better.
** '''Jethick:''' Anyway, you clearly didn't come here to talk about kings. So tell me, what brings you to West Ardougne?
* '''Jethick:''' I don't suppose you could run me a little errand while you're over there? I borrowed this book from them, can you return it?
